Chapter 01 — About

I'm a marketer in training — someone who learns by doing, not just reading the case study.

I'm Ritika Garg, currently pursuing my MBA in Digital Marketing & Operations at Lovely Professional University. I'm drawn to business problems that need both a plan and a pair of hands — the kind you only really understand once you've worked inside them.

Across internships and independent projects, I've picked up practical experience in banking operations, e-commerce, affiliate marketing, Shopify storefronts and financial analysis. I like collaborative rooms, I take the first step without waiting to be asked, and I'm most comfortable when I'm mid-way through learning something new.

The goal is simple: a career built on contributing to real business growth — through innovation, teamwork, and staying curious long after graduation.
